AccessEffect.description: One effect of a change, as a rule ("loses Kestrel Bank"); never a document.

subject.description: The account, department or group added or removed.

AccessEffect.title: AccessEffect

name.description: The member's name; null if no longer a member.
name.title: Name

message.description: A fixed sentence for the status, or null.
message.title: Message

AskRequest.description:
What a client may send. Nothing here is authority: the organization and member come
from the session, every access fact from the database; ``classification`` can only
raise the question's sensitivity (D-13).
AskRequest.title: AskRequest

details.description: Provider and egress settings events, and identity changes from the identity provider (user name, e-mail, name).
details.title: Details

document.description: The target document. Events about documents you cannot read now are not listed.

evidence_id.description: The chunk ID of an item in `evidence`.
evidence_id.title: Evidence Id

quote_start.description: Offset of the quote in the evidence text.
quote_start.title: Quote Start

organization.description: Organization slug; required only when the persona has several.
organization.title: Organization

Directory.description:
What an administrator may assign: every account and department, and the
administrator-defined groups (source-synced groups are owned by their source).
Directory.title: Directory

DocumentExplanation.description: Why the member can or cannot read a document you can read (``explain_for_reviewer``).
DocumentExplanation.title: DocumentExplanation

DocumentRef.description: A document the viewing administrator can read.
DocumentRef.title: DocumentRef

ErrorDetail.description: One problem with the request. Never contains the submitted value.
ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

EvidenceDetail.description: ``GET /v1/evidence/{id}``: one readable chunk, for the inspector.

char_start.description: Offset of this chunk in its document body.
char_start.title: Char Start

EvidenceDetail.title: EvidenceDetail

EvidenceItem.description: A permitted chunk the asker may read (D-8: the account only when visible).
EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem

record_kind.description: identifier: the record's ID (you can read its document); opaque: a keyed reference only.
record_kind.title: Record Kind

granted_by.description: The administrator who granted it, if recorded.
granted_by.title: Granted By

revocable.description: Administrator grants only; source grants follow the source.
revocable.title: Revocable

name.description: Null for a private group you are not in (nothing else is given).
name.title: Name

capabilities.description: Administrative capabilities. None of them grants access to content.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

grants.description: Grants on documents you can read.
grants.title: Grants

groups.description: Administrator-defined groups, and synced groups you are a member of.
groups.title: Groups

has_hidden_groups.description: The member is in private groups you are not in (not named, listed, counted or identified).
has_hidden_groups.title: Has Hidden Groups

has_other_grants.description: The member has grants on documents you cannot read (not listed or counted).
has_other_grants.title: Has Other Grants

is_self.description: Your own membership: it cannot be changed here.
is_self.title: Is Self

version.description: Send back as `version` with a change; a stale value is refused (409).
version.title: Version

MemberAccounts.description: The accounts you may know exist -- the only ones an Ask scope may name.
MemberAccounts.title: MemberAccounts

MemberChange.description:
A proposed change. Omitted fields stay as they are; ``accounts``,
``departments`` and ``groups`` are complete sets (groups: the
administrator-defined groups only; source-group membership is untouched).
MemberChange.title: MemberChange

readable_documents.description: Active documents you can read here.
readable_documents.title: Readable Documents

is_admin.description: Administrative capability; grants no content access.
is_admin.title: Is Admin

managed_by.description: Provisioned by the organization's identity provider (SCIM): it owns the member's name, e-mail and whether they are active; access stays editable here.
managed_by.title: Managed By

role_label.description: Display only; never an access input.
role_label.title: Role Label

next_after.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; null on the last page.
next_after.title: Next After

role_label.description: Display label only; not a permission.
role_label.title: Role Label

NamedRef.description: An entity named in an audit event; ``name`` is ``None`` when it no longer exists.
NamedRef.title: NamedRef

RetrievalScope.description:
Optional filters. Each is ANDed with the authorization predicate: it can narrow
what the reader may see, never widen it. ``account`` must name an account the
reader may know exists (``authz.visible_accounts_predicate``); a hidden or unknown
account is refused identically.
RetrievalScope.title: RetrievalScope
